<!-- pr-reviewer: e2291de8af3f307b7ed76d79b8d910d226f4580c -->
**Needs changes before merge** - the #575 change itself is right, but the stacked Tormach probe goldens are stale against current `main`.

## What looks good
- `tormach.cps` `onProbeResult`: `(DEBUG, PROBE <axis> ERROR #19n)` is emitted once per axis, after that axis's `o90n endif` tolerance test and before `G10 L20` (and before the MSG/M0 in measure-only, pinned by `tormach_measure_only_reports_before_its_stop`). DEBUG is non-stopping, which matches the real-control check on the 770MX (two runs, program ran to the end).
- Fanuc family emits nothing; the reasoning is recorded in `fanuc.cps` and `docs/decisions/575-probe-report.md`. Fanuc probe goldens and cutting goldens are untouched by the #583-only commit (diff beyond #521 head ea18ff81 is 10 files: 2 .cps, 6 Tormach goldens, `probe_report.rs`, the decision file).
- No Rust source, `build.rs`, `.github`, scripts or dependency changes; no unwrap/panic concerns. Clean-room citations are public (LinuxCNC reference, Siemens/TNC manuals). Decision file is per-PR, body ends `Fixes #575` with a `Changelog:` line, no CHANGELOG.md edit, no snapshot PNGs.

## Local results (trial-merged with upstream/main 66791aa6, clean merge, no conflicts)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| probe_report | 4 passed |
| probe_op | 12 passed |
| conformance | 6 passed |
| posting | 17 passed |
| tormach_post | 10 passed |
| fanuc_post | 11 passed |
| probe_reach | 5 passed |
| **probe_tormach** | **1 passed, 6 FAILED** |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

probe_tormach failures (face, edge, corner, bore, bore_mm, boss), e.g. `face_posts_g38_2_and_sets_z_on_the_770mx`:
```
golden .../golden/nc/tormach/probe_face.nc is stale; regenerate with WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test
 generated has:  G38.3 X0.3937 Y0.1969 Z1.9685 F11.81
                 o5001 if [#5070 EQ 1]
                 (MSG, PROBE HIT ON POSITIONING)
                 M2
                 o5001 endif
 golden has:     G1 X0.3937 Y0.1969 Z1.9685 F11.81
```
Cause: `main` now carries 453142b4 (probe positioning moves post as protected G38.3 moves, #570/#579). The six Tormach goldens come from the stacked #521 and were generated before that; the new DEBUG line is correct in them, but the surrounding positioning move is not. The `probe_tormach` test names in the PR body (7 pass) hold only on the pre-merge head. The same staleness hits #521 itself.

## Requested before merge
1. After #521 is brought up to date with `main` (or on this branch if it merges first), regenerate the six goldens `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach/probe_{face,edge,corner,bore_centre,bore_centre_mm,boss_centre}.nc` with `WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p camcraft-app --test probe_tormach`, check that the only diffs are the G38.3 + `o5001` positioning block (plus the DEBUG lines), and re-gate `probe_tormach` and `probe_report`. Note the PR is flagged ready, so per AGENTS.md this needs `gh pr ready 583 --undo`, the push, then ready again.

## Notes (not blocking)
- Real-control confirmation of the DEBUG line is already in the PR comment (770MX, PathPilot 2.14.4); thanks.
- The PR cannot merge before #521; its diff against `main` still lists #521's files.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: d3217facf4863761c2112f6ad16039cf823f8ee4 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (re-review at d3217fac; the earlier stale-golden blocker is fixed). Note this PR is stacked on #521 and carries its commits; #521 should merge first.

**What looks good**
- The six Tormach probe goldens are regenerated: every positioning move is now a protected `G38.3` followed by the `o5001 if [#5070 EQ 1]` / `(MSG, PROBE HIT ON POSITIONING)` / `M2` block, and each probed axis gets its `(DEBUG, PROBE <axis> ERROR #19n <unit>)` line.
- Placement is right: DEBUG comes after the axis's `o90n endif` tolerance test and before `G10 L20` (probe_face.nc:26-33, probe_bore_centre_mm.nc:58-71). The unit word follows the program units (`IN` in the inch goldens, `MM` in probe_bore_centre_mm.nc).
- Cutting-op goldens are untouched. The only golden outside the new probe files is `probe_guard_moves.nc` losing `S0 M3`, which commit 94326684 explains (a 0 rpm touch probe starts no spindle).
- Fanuc gets only a provenance comment (output unchanged). A decision record is included. No build.rs, `.github`, scripts, dependency, CHANGELOG or snapshot PNG changes. `tormach.cps` and `fanuc.cps` are post scripts (exempt from the 400-line rule).

**Local results** (merged with upstream/main, which was already contained; no conflicts)
| check | result |
|---|---|
| probe_tormach | 7 pass |
| probe_report | 5 pass (incl. `tormach_mm_program_reports_in_mm`) |
| probe_op | 12 pass |
| tormach_post / fanuc_post / posting | 3 / 9 / 3 pass (also 33, 11, 17, 10 in the other app suites run) |
| camcraft-post | 0 tests, ok |
| clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -D warnings | clean |
UI suites not run (no UI change).

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The new goldens assume #521 lands first; the PR body says so.
- Seeing the DEBUG line on the real control is still unexercised, as the body states.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
